statements.subject: client
statements.description: When a UAC sends a request that can establish a dialog (such as an INVITE) it MUST provide a SIP or SIPS URI with global scope (i.e., the same SIP URI can be used in messages outside this dialog) in the Contact header field of the request.
actions: include SIP or SIPS URI with global scope in Contact header field of request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the request has a Request-URI or a topmost Route header field value with a SIPS URI, the Contact header field MUST contain a SIPS URI.
actions: set Contact header field to SIPS URI

statements.subject: client
statements.description: This state MUST be maintained for the duration of the dialog.
actions: maintain constructed dialog state for the duration of the dialog

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The route set MUST be set to the list of URIs in the Record-Route header field from the response, taken in reverse order and preserving all URI parameters.
actions: set route set to Record-Route URIs from response in reverse order preserving all URI parameters

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If no Record-Route header field is present in the response, the route set MUST be set to the empty set.
actions: set route set to empty set

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The remote target MUST be set to the URI from the Contact header field of the response.
actions: set remote target to URI from Contact header field of response

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The local sequence number MUST be set to the value of the sequence number in the CSeq header field of the request.
actions: set local sequence number to sequence number from CSeq header field of request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The remote sequence number MUST be empty (it is established when the remote UA sends a request within the dialog).
actions: set remote sequence number to empty

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The call identifier component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the value of the Call-ID in the request.
actions: set call identifier component of dialog ID to value of Call-ID from request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The local tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the From field in the request, and the remote tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the To field of the response.
actions: set local tag component of dialog ID to tag in From field of request

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The local tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the From field in the request, and the remote tag component of the dialog ID MUST be set to the tag in the To field of the response.
actions: set remote tag component of dialog ID to tag in To field of response

statements.subject: client
statements.description: A UAC MUST be prepared to receive a response without a tag in the To field, in which case the tag is considered to have a value of null.
actions: accept response with no To tag
treat absent To tag as null value for remote tag component

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The remote URI MUST be set to the URI in the To field, and the local URI MUST be set to the URI in the From field.
actions: set remote URI to URI in To field of response

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The remote URI MUST be set to the URI in the To field, and the local URI MUST be set to the URI in the From field.
actions: set local URI to URI in From field of request
